title: 第23 章 当路君下第 24章 术法遗症
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 那些人走了吗？
它不知道。它得再等等。
第二天，它又趴在山梁上往下看。
山道上空荡荡的，一个人影也没有。
狼妖趴了一整天，确定那些人都走了，才慢慢从山上下来。
它又回到了那块石头边上。
它趴上去，让月光把自己浸透，心里头却怎么也静不下来。
它想起那些人拿着长矛的样子，想起那些铜锣声，想起敲锣的人那张哭得稀里哗啦的脸。
它忽然有点儿明白那头老虎了。
那畜牲不是蠢，是没想到人能那么麻烦。
打死一个来两个，打死两个来四个，打死四个来一群。
怎么也打不完，怎么也杀不绝。
狼妖不一样。
它瘸着一条腿活了这几十年，靠的就是躲。躲不过就跑，跑不过就藏。
这山这么大，林子这么密，它往里头一钻，谁能找着它？
那些人走了，它再出来。那些人来了，它再躲回去。
反正它有得是时间。
它活了几十年，再活几十年也没问题。那些人能活多久？
几十年顶天了。
等他们老死了，死了，它再下山刨他们的坟，吃他们的肉。
狼妖趴在那块石头上，眯着眼，望着山下那个隐隐约约的村庄，忽然咧开嘴，露出那一排新长出来的白生生的牙。
它在笑。
再后来，狼妖嘴里就能喷黑风了。
它对着山里的野猪试过，一口黑风喷出去，那畜牲的眼珠子当场就瞎了，满山乱撞，最后被它一口咬死。
它很满意自己身上的变化，觉得这吃人肉真是比晒月亮好使。
可渐渐地，那些人不上山了。
它趴在石头后头，舔了舔嘴唇。
很久没吃人了，嘴里那股子腥甜味儿都快忘了。
它有时候想下山，去那个村子里转转，叼一个就跑。
可它又有点怕。
那些人太多了，手里有锄头有镰刀，它再厉害也架不住对面一群。
它真的不想受伤。
它只能等。
等着哪个不怕死的再上山来。
然后，这个人就来了。
狼妖眯着眼，盯着那个白嫩嫩的男人。
他走路的姿态和那些樵夫不一样，腰背挺得很直，一步一步，不紧不慢，像是在自己家院子里散步。
它看着那个男人，心里动了动。
那人让它有点不自在。说不上来为什么，就是觉得靠近他的话，会有麻烦。
可那白花花的肉……
它又咽了口唾沫。
content_en:
Are those people gone?
It doesn't know. It will have to wait.
The next day, it lay on the ridge again and looked down.
The mountain road was deserted, not a single soul in sight.
The wolf demon lay down all day, making sure that all those people were gone, and then slowly came down from the mountain.
It returned to the stone.
It lay down and let the moonlight soak it, but its heart couldn't calm down.
It remembered the look of those men holding spears, the sound of those gongs, and the crying faces of those who struck the gongs.
It suddenly understood the tiger a little bit.
That beast wasn't stupid, he just didn't expect people to be so troublesome.
Kill one and come two, kill two and come four, kill four and come together as a group.
No matter how hard we fight, we can't finish them, and we can't stop killing them no matter what.
The wolf demon is different.
It has survived for decades with one leg lame, relying on hiding. If you can't hide, run; if you can't run, hide.
The mountain is so big and the forest is so dense. If it burrows into it, who can find it?
When those people leave, it comes out again. When those people come, it hides back.
It has plenty of time anyway.
It has lived for decades, and it has no problem living for several more decades. How long can those people live?
It’s held up for decades.
When they die of old age, it will go down the mountain to dig their graves and eat their flesh.
The wolf demon was lying on the rock, squinting and looking at the faint village at the foot of the mountain. He suddenly grinned, revealing a row of newly grown white teeth.
It's laughing.
…
Later, the wolf demon will be able to spray black wind from its mouth.
It tried it on a wild boar in the mountains, and when it blew out a breath of black wind, the beast's eyes were blinded on the spot. It bumped all over the mountain and was finally bitten to death by it.
It is very satisfied with the changes in its body and feels that eating human flesh is better than basking in the moon.
But gradually, those people stopped going up the mountain.
It lay down behind the stone and licked its lips.
It’s been a long time since I’ve eaten a human, and I’ve almost forgotten the fishy-sweet taste in my mouth.
Sometimes it wants to go down the mountain, go to that village, pick one up and run away.
But it's a little scared.
There are too many of them, and they all have hoes and sickles in their hands. No matter how powerful it is, it can't stand up to the group on the opposite side.
It really doesn't want to get hurt.
It can only wait.
Waiting for someone who is not afraid of death to come up the mountain again.
Then, this person came.
The wolf demon squinted his eyes and stared at the fair and tender man.
His walking posture was different from those of the woodcutter. His back was straight and he took one step at a time, as if he was walking in his own yard.
It looked at the man and felt something in its heart.
The man made it a little uncomfortable. I couldn't explain why, but I just felt that if I got close to him, I would be in trouble.
But that white flesh...
It swallowed again.
